If the person can only communicate through Makaton, a person trained in Makaton (a licenced
“Makaton tutor”) would be required to interpret. It is important to avoid jargon and bear in mind
that the person’s vocabulary may be limited. Sentences should be kept short and clear.
More information on Makaton is available at www.makaton.org.
